name: rate_limit_403
notes: E27: 403 with x-ratelimit-remaining: 0. The client waits for x-ratelimit-reset but no longer than GITHUB_MAX_WAIT (60 s), then fails the stage — fatal in S1, degrading in S2 and S8. x-ratelimit-reset here is 25 s after the recorded date header, deliberately inside the default wait budget.

body.message: API rate limit exceeded for user ID 583231.
